name: Math Word Problems (smoke)
description: Small original suite of grade-school arithmetic word problems. The numeric grader parses the final number of the response and applies a tolerance, so formatting differences are tolerated.
provenance: Hand-written by the FSOCIETY AI maintainers. This is NOT GSM8K, MATH, AIME or any official math benchmark; no dataset items were copied. It is a deterministic smoke check for arithmetic reasoning and answer extraction.
limitations: Ten items only: a single arithmetic slip dominates the score.
The grader takes the last number in the response; verbose answers can hide the correct value.
No chain-of-thought verification; only the final numeric value is checked.
Not representative of competition mathematics or multi-step symbolic reasoning.

items.prompt: A workshop produces 18 widgets every hour. How many widgets does it produce in 7 hours? End with the final number.
Marta buys 3 notebooks at 4.50 each and a pen for 2.25. What is the total cost? End with the final number.
A train travels 240 kilometres in 3 hours at a constant speed. How many kilometres per hour does it travel? End with the final number.
A bag contains 5 red marbles and 7 blue marbles. How many marbles are in the bag in total? End with the final number.
A recipe needs three quarters of a cup of sugar per batch. How many cups of sugar are needed for 6 batches? End with the final number.
A shirt costs 40 and is discounted by 15 percent. What is the final price? End with the final number.
A sequence starts at 7 and adds 5 at each step. What is the 9th term of the sequence? End with the final number.
A tank holds 120 litres and is 35 percent full. How many litres of liquid are in the tank? End with the final number.
Ana reads 25 pages per day. How many days does she need to finish a 400-page book? End with the final number.
Three friends split 87 coins equally with no remainder. How many coins does each friend receive? End with the final number.
